name: Arhaus, Inc.
summary: Arhaus, Inc. operates as a premium retailer in the home furnishings market in the United States. The company offers bedroom, dining room, and living room, as well as home office furnishings, including sofas, dining tables and chairs, accent chairs, console and coffee tables, beds, headboards, dressers, desks, bookcases, modular storage, and other items; and outdoor products, such as outdoor dining tables, chairs, chaises and other furniture, lighting, textiles, décor, umbrellas, and fire pits. It also provides bath product assortment comprising vanities and storage pieces, faucets and hardware, and Turkish bath towels; lighting fixtures, including chandeliers, pendants, table and floor lamps…
